rule.title: React Hook Form Combined with Zod Schema Resolver
rule.statement: All forms must be managed with React Hook Form and validated against a shared Zod schema using @hookform/resolvers/zod.
rule.rationale: Manual useState form management causes unnecessary re-renders on every keystroke and leads to duplicate validation logic between client and server.
rule.implementation_guidance: useForm({ resolver: zodResolver(schema) }). Disable submit button while formState.isSubmitting is true.

forbidden.example: Managing 10 separate useState hooks for form inputs with manual regex checks in an onSubmit handler.

preferred.example: const { register, handleSubmit, formState } = useForm({ resolver: zodResolver(loginSchema) });

source.book_title: Learn React with TypeScript - Third Edition
source.evidence_quote: Using React Hook Form with Zod schemas ensures type-safe forms with minimal re-renders and aligns frontend validation directly with backend contracts.

rule.title: Server Actions Mutation Lifecycle with useActionState and useOptimistic
rule.statement: Mutations executed via Next.js Server Actions must be managed in the UI using React 19's useActionState and useOptimistic to provide immediate user feedback and progressive enhancement.
rule.rationale: Manual async state tracking with multiple useState and useEffect hooks creates race conditions and fails to leverage React 19 concurrent transition boundaries.
rule.implementation_guidance: Define 'use server' actions that return typed state { success, error, data }. In the client component, bind the action using const [state, formAction, isPending] = useActionState(serverAction, initialState).

forbidden.example: const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false); const handleSubmit = async () => { setLoading(true); await serverAction(); setLoading(false); };

preferred.example: const [state, formAction, isPending] = useActionState(deleteDocumentAction, null); const [optimisticDocs, setOptimistic] = useOptimistic(docs, updateFn);

source.chapter: Chapter 7: Server Actions and Concurrent Mutations
source.evidence_quote: Server Actions combined with useActionState streamline form lifecycles, enabling type-safe server validation and optimistic state updates with zero boilerplate.
